paragraphs: What up! It's your boy James, on the God and Jesus squad, hitting up the twelve tribes scattered all over the place. Hello!
§Faith Under Pressure

Hey, when life throws shade and you're getting hit from all sides, consider it an amazing change opportunity. It's like growing your faith game. Don't try to quit early. Let it cook so you can become a real one, not a noob. You'll end up mature and solid, a true pro, ready for anything.

If you're clueless, just hit up God. He's not gonna roast you for asking. He loves to help. Just ask like you mean it, seriously. Don't be all wishy-washy, or you'll get ghosted. People who pray without really believing are like a boat getting tossed around in a storm. You won't get anything from God that way.

When the underdog gets a win, hype 'em up! And when the rich kid who flexes all the time gets put in his place, that's a W too. Being rich is temporary, like a passing cloud. One minute you're ballin', the next you're broke. The sun comes out, the flower wilts, and all that's left is a dry stick. That's what happens to the so-called 'prosperous life.'
Anyone who faces a challenge and doesn't quit is a legend. If you're loyal to God, you get the ultimate prize: life on beast mode.

Don't blame God when you're tempted to do something sus. That's on you, fam. Your own desires are the ones trying to get you to mess up. That's how sin is born, and it grows up to be a straight-up killer.
So for real, my guys, don't get played. All the good stuff comes from God. He's the OG, and He doesn't switch up. He made us with his true Word, and we're the crown of all he created.
§Act on What You Hear

Alright, listen up. Be quick to listen, slow to speak, and even slower to get angry. Getting mad doesn't make you right with God. So trash all the toxic stuff in your life. Let God do his thing and landscape your life with the Word, making a salvation-garden of your life.
Don't just listen to the Word and do nothing. That's like looking in the mirror, walking away, and immediately forgetting what you look like. You gotta *do* what it says.

But whoever catches a glimpse of God's revealed counsel — the free life! — even out of the corner of their eye, and sticks with it, is no distracted scatterbrain but a person of action. That person will find delight and affirmation in the action.

If you think you're religious but you can't control your mouth, you're just fooling yourself. Your religion is empty. The kind of religion that God our Father accepts as pure and faultless is this: to look after orphans and widows in their distress and to keep yourself from being polluted by the world. That's real talk.

title: Don't Be a Poser
changes: Ch2: replaced EN-added §Faith and Actions with MSG own header §The Royal Rule of Love (badged 1-4)
Ch2: added MSG own header §Faith in Action (badged 14-17) in EN and KO
Ch2: replaced KO-only headers §믿음과 행동 with §사랑이라는 고귀한 법 (badged 1-4)
paragraphs: §The Royal Rule of Love

Alright, listen up. When you say you're all about Jesus, don't let what other people think mess with your head. Seriously, don't be a poser. If some rich guy in a fancy suit walks into your church, and then a homeless guy in rags comes in, you can't just give the rich guy the special treatment and tell the other guy to go sit in the back. If you do that, you're totally missing the point and being a biased judge.

God's not like that at all. He rolls with the underdogs and makes them first citizens of his kingdom, with full rights and privileges. This kingdom is for anyone who loves God. But here you are, dissing the very people God chose! And who are the ones making your life hard? The rich and powerful, that's who. They're the ones dragging you to court and making fun of you for being a Christian.

There's one main rule: "Love others as much as you love yourself." If you're buttering up the "important" people, you're breaking that rule, big time. You can't just pick and choose which of God's rules you want to follow. It's an all-or-nothing deal. If you don't cheat on your girlfriend but you go and murder someone, you're still a murderer. You don't get points for not cheating.

So, act like you know you're going to be judged by the rule that sets you free. If you're not kind to others, don't expect them to be kind to you. Mercy always wins against judgment, every single time.
§Faith in Action

Look, you can't just talk the talk; you have to walk the walk. It's not enough to say you have faith. If you see a friend who's broke and hungry and you're just like, "Hey, hope you feel better!" and then walk away without helping them out, what good is that? It's just empty words. Faith without action is just nonsense.

Someone might say, "Okay, you do the faith stuff, and I'll do the good deeds." But it doesn't work like that. You can't have one without the other. Faith and actions go together like peanut butter and jelly.

So you believe in God? That's cool, but even the demons believe in God, and it doesn't do them any good. You have to use your brain. Faith and good deeds are a package deal. You can't separate them, or you just end up with a whole lot of nothing.

Think about Abraham. He was considered a friend of God because he was willing to do what God asked, even when it was super hard. His faith was shown through his actions. It's the combination of believing and doing that makes you right with God.

And what about Rahab? She was an immoral woman, but she had faith and hid the spies that God sent. Her actions showed her faith, and that's what mattered to God. The moment you separate faith from action, you've got nothing. It's like a body without a spirit—it's just a corpse.

paragraphs: §When You Open Your Mouth

Hey, don't be so quick to jump into the spotlight and be a leader or a teacher. That's some serious business, and you get judged way harder. Let's be real, none of us are perfect. We all mess up and say clueless stuff. If you found someone who never said anything wrong, you'd have found a perfect person who has their whole life on lock.

Think about it. A tiny piece of metal in a horse's mouth can steer the whole animal. A small rudder can turn a giant ship. In the same way, the words you say might seem like no big deal, but they can either build things up or tear everything down.

It just takes one little spark to start a huge forest fire, and a careless word can do the same kind of damage. You can totally wreck someone's reputation, stir up drama, and basically set the world on fire with your mouth.

And here's the crazy part: you can train a wild animal, but you can't tame your own tongue. It's got a mind of its own, and it can be deadly. One minute you're using it to praise God, and the next you're using it to roast people that He created. Blessing and cursing from the same mouth?

Seriously, my friends, this can't go on. A spring doesn't gush fresh water one day and brackish the next, right? Apple trees don't bear strawberries, and raspberry bushes don't bear apples. You're not going to dip into a polluted mud hole and get a cup of clear, cool water, are you?
§Live Well, Live Wisely

If you want to be known as wise, then you gotta walk the walk, not just talk the talk. Live a good, smart, and humble life. It's your actions that matter, not your bragging. Trying to make yourself look good by putting others down isn't wisdom, it's just being a hater. Twisting the truth to sound smart is just a lie. That kind of stuff is just petty, and it only leads to fights and everyone turning on each other.

Real wisdom, the kind that comes from God, starts with living right and being cool with people. It's about being gentle, reasonable, and full of mercy. It's not about being hot one day and cold the next, or being two-faced. If you put in the work to get along with people and treat them with respect, you'll build a solid community and see the awesome results.

title: Quit Being a Salty Hater

Ch4: removed KO-only headers §하나님께 진지해져라 / "하나님 뜻대로 사는 삶" / §편을 골라라
paragraphs: §Get Serious

Hey, where do you think all this drama and fighting comes from? You think it just happens? Nah, man. It's because you're all about what *you* want, and you're ready to throw down for it. You get super salty about what you don't have and you'd even consider taking someone out to get it. You're fiending for what's not yours and will get violent to snatch it.

But you never think to just ask God for it, do you? And you know why? Because you know you're asking for stuff you have no business asking for. You're all a bunch of spoiled brats, each one wanting to be the main character.

You're basically two-timing God. If all you care about is your own way, always chasing after what the world thinks is cool, you're making yourself God's opp. And you think God's cool with that? No way. The old saying is true: "He's a fiercely jealous lover." And the stuff He gives you is way better than anything else you'll find. Everyone knows that "God roasts the proud, but gives an incredible renewal to the humble."

So, let God do His thing in you. Tell the devil to go away, and watch him dip. Give a quiet "bet" to God, and He'll come close to you in no time. Stop messing around with sin. Clean up your inner life. Quit playing games. It's time to get real. The party's over. Get serious. Bow down to the Boss; it's the only way you'll ever truly grow.

And stop roasting each other, my guys. When you trash-talk your friends, you're basically dissing God's rules. You're supposed to be living out the message, not tagging it with graffiti. God's the one who's the ultimate judge of everyone's story. Who are you to be the judge of someone else's?
§Nothing but a Wisp of Fog

And for all you guys who are like, "Alright, squad, tomorrow we're hitting up this city, starting a business, and we're gonna be rich!" You don't even know what's gonna happen tomorrow. You're like a puff of smoke, here for a second and then gone. Instead, you should be saying, "If the Boss is cool with it and we're still breathing, we'll do this or that."
But no, you're too busy flexing. All that bragging is just cringe. In fact, if you know the right thing to do and you just don't do it, that's a major L for you.

title: Rich People Problems and How to Be a Real MVP
changes: Ch5: replaced EN-added §Warning to the Rich with MSG own header §Destroying Your Life from Within (badged 1-3)

paragraphs: §Destroying Your Life from Within

Alright, listen up, all you rich folks who think you're all that. You better get ready to cry a river, because a storm is coming for your stacks of cash. Your money's basically rotting, and those fancy clothes you flex are starting to stink. All your expensive toys are like a disease eating you up from the inside. You thought you were getting rich, but you were just collecting trouble.

And all those people you ripped off to get your money? They're screaming for justice. The big Boss upstairs hears every single one of them. You've been living the high life, treating the world like your personal piggy bank. But in the end, all you'll have to show for it is a super-sized coffin. You've totally wrecked the lives of good people who didn't even fight back.

But for the rest of you, my friends, just hang in there. The Boss is coming back. Think about farmers. They plant their seeds and then have to wait forever for the crops to grow, right? They just trust the process. That's how you need to be. Just chill, stay strong. The Boss could show up any minute.
And hey, stop whining about each other. You've got way bigger things to worry about. The ultimate Judge is literally right around the corner, ready to drop the gavel.

Look at the old-school prophets. They were total legends. They went through the worst stuff ever and never gave up on God. That's what you call a powerful shift. You've all heard about Job, right? That guy had the worst luck, but he kept his faith and God totally came through for him in the end. That's because God's got your back, down to the smallest thing.

And since you know God's on your side, make sure your words show it. Don't be extra and say stuff like "I swear to God" all the time. Just be real. Say "yes" when you mean yes, and "no" when you mean no. Keep it simple, so you don't get yourself into trouble.
§Prayer to Be Reckoned With

If you're going through a tough time, pray. Feeling awesome? Sing about it. If you're sick, get your church's distinguished leaders to pray for you and anoint you with oil in the name of the Master. A real prayer from a true believer is like a superpower. It can heal you, and Jesus will get you back on your feet. And if you've messed up, you'll be forgiven. You'll get a life-changing moment.

So, make it a habit to be real with each other. Admit when you've messed up and pray for each other. That's how you build a strong crew. The prayer of a good person is no joke. Remember Elijah? He was just a regular guy like us, but he prayed for a drought, and it didn't rain for three and a half years. Then he prayed for rain, and boom, it started pouring and everything started growing again. That's some serious power.

My friends, if you see someone in your crew wandering off and getting lost, don't just ghost them. Go get them. Bring them back. You'll be saving their life and stopping a whole lot of other people from making the same mistake.
